sloka: निवृत्तवनवासं च त्वया सार्धमरिन्दमम् ।अभिषिक्तमयोध्यायां क्षिप्रं द्रक्ष्यसि राघवम् ।। ५.६८.२८ ।।।।
transliteration: nivṛttavanavāsaṁ ca tvayā sārdhamarindamam ।abhiṣiktamayodhyāyāṁ kṣipraṁ drakṣyasi rāghavam ।। 5.68.28 ।।।।

translations.english: 'You will soon see Rama, the slayer of enemies crowned as king of Ayodhya with you, having duly completed the term of exile in the forest'.
